context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 contact sheets, each 48 frames sampled evenly (6 columns x 8 rows, chronological) from a single Tesla Sentry Mode field clip recorded by the owner's own car. For EACH image, decide whether anything physically touched the car anywhere in the clip. Output exactly one line per event:
<event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 12 words>
Definitions: contact = something physically touches the car; near_miss = a person or object approaches closely but no contact is visible; quiet = nobody/nothing approaches; unclear = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: 2026-09-10_12-32-48
Image 2: 2026-09-10_13-10-10
Image 3: 2026-09-10_13-42-12
Image 4: 2026-09-10_13-44-18
Image 5: 2026-09-10_17-02-19
response:
2026-09-10_12-32-48: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=person beside neighboring SUV; CONFIDENCE=low; NOTE=Stands beside recording car; hands move outside view, obscuring possible contact.
2026-09-10_13-10-10: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=person walking dog; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Person and dog pass close; no contact with recording car visible.
2026-09-10_13-42-12: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=pedestrian; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Walks closely past recording car without visible contact.
2026-09-10_13-44-18: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=pedestrian; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Passes close beside recording car; no touching visible.
2026-09-10_17-02-19: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=person near charging stations; CONFIDENCE=low; NOTE=Returns toward recording car and extends arm; contact point outside view.
